title: docs(pm-skill): write the third platform-readings increment and measure it at +36 against the 358 ceiling
body:
Fixes #15192
Part of #15275

The third increment of the `platform-readings.md` intake, now **landed under its
ruling**. The measurement flight wrote and counted the members and left the ceiling
alone; this patch round takes the ruling and raises it. The gate is **green**.

Attribution, as prose so it survives an edit: produced by Claude Code, session
`https://claude.ai/code/session_019RfFHiRCSs3JXLK4cwcfox`.

## The ruling this executes

Maintainer, decision batch #34, 2026-09-04, on the recommendation presented for the
sizing card — verbatim and untranslated:

> 「决裁批 #34 同意」

The director record states what that adopts, item by item:

- **Item 1 = A** — "raise the ceiling by the measured +39, 358 → 397". All four
  members land as written. It is an **ORDINARY** raise under the ratchet's own
  maintainer exit, not a cross-file move.
- **Item 2 = C** — the two quota sentences this increment leaves in tension stay
  exactly as the measurement flight wrote them, pending a discriminating read. ⛔
  Neither was edited, here or in the readings file.

## Per member, measured rather than estimated

Each member was written in the file's own voice and wrapped by the gate's own
`wrapLine` imported from the ratchet script — the canonical form, so no line can
be over budget and no break lands on a junction that renders as a space. 120
**bytes** per line, not columns.

| member | source | placement | +lines |
|---|---|---|--:|
| attribution footer, scoped per CHANNEL **and** per ACTION/INPUT | the two post-ruling channel readings recorded on the chain head, the second raw-REST observation on the card, the services seat's third observation, and a fourth measured by this flight | 读数陷阱, directly after the existing PR-body footer bullet | +12 |
| MCP-side rate refusal is a window reading, not a PR signal | the post-ruling rate-budget reading recorded on the chain head | API 配额, after the 红窗调度 row | +6 |
| the CDN cause behind 「本档的缺席不是读数」 | the CDN-staleness card's measurement | API 配额, at the end of the payload-channel bullet | +5 |
| Routine transport: no connector tools in a fired session · self-binding's trade and its orphan-recovery rule · no `sources` / no `model` on the create end | the Routine transport card, re-checked against this session's tool contract | 断粮 section, after the existing timer paragraph | +16 |
| | | **total** | **+39** |

358 + 39 = **397**, and the file landed at exactly that. Nothing was shortened to
fit and nothing was padded to reach it.

## What the ratchet script changed, and why `was` did not move

Two edits, both in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`:

1. **The ceiling row** `platform-readings.md` 358 → **397**, with this ruling
   quoted verbatim beside it and the four members accounted for line by line —
   the same shape the row above uses for the previous raise. The earlier comment
   and its 358 history are kept intact; the new text is an addition. Item 2's
   disposition is recorded there too, so the next author does not "tidy" a
   deliberate tension away.
2. **A second `ruledRaises` record** on the same file's `CROSS_FILE_MOVES`
   declaration, carrying this ruling as a verbatim quotation and `delta: 39`.

⛔ **`was` stays `314`** — this file's literal pre-move ceiling — and is never
carried forward. That is the whole point of the `ruledRaises` shape: an ordinary
ruled raise is the **maintainer's**, so it neither re-opens the move nor pays it
down, and it is subtracted before the move is priced. With both records the
arithmetic is 397 − 314 − (34 + 39) = **+10**, against the same net source
decrease of 11 the move landed with. The over-claim bar still holds, since the 73
lines of ruled raise are less than the gross 83.

## Gate verdicts, all green at `40cb0c59`

```

✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: cross-file move into .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md: +10 (314→397, less 73 lines of ordinary ruled raise) against a net source decrease of 11 (.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/cli.md 35→31, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/services.md 30→28, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/rest-channel.md 93→88); authorised by #14685 item 5 (comment 5520452691).
✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: declared cross-file moves: 1, total ceilings down 1 line.
✓ check-skill-line-ratchet self-test: 155 cases pass.
```

Headroom is **0**, the same convention every other entry in the map keeps. The
self-test's live-registry case — "every live ruled-raise record quotes its ruling,
dates it, and names a positive line count" — passes over both records.
